clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope— Specifies the dimensional requirements for rubber gaskets to be used in cast iron pipes/fittings for the mechnical joints and push-on flexible joints for carrying water, gas and sewage.

clauses.title: Requirement for Gaskets
clauses.text: 2. Requirement for Gaskets — As per IS   5382 : 1985*.
